## Overview

TEMPMEKO–ISHM is an international metrology symposium focused on temperature, humidity, moisture, and related thermophysical quantities. The conference routinely includes contributions on radiation thermometry, calibration, uncertainty evaluation, and reference sources, where emissivity determination and characterization appear as recurring technical topics. Attendance commonly includes national metrology institutes, calibration laboratories, and academic groups.
